title: handroanthus umbellatus
intro: Handroanthus umbellatus, commonly known as the Brazil cedar tree or itatá, is a plant species native to South America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, and its extracts are used to treat various health conditions. Handroanthus umbellatus is rich in bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions and health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Handroanthus umbellatus include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are beneficial for treating conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory infections.
